items.prompt: Reported cash exceeds fill-sum expected cash by3cents. What follows?

options.why: The size alone does not prove which source/event is wrong.

options.text: A missing fee is proved and may be invented
options.why: Several causes can create the same difference.

options.text: Change the fill price until the ledger agrees
A balanced position proves cash is correct
options.why: Cash and position checks catch different errors.

items.explanation: Reconciliation surfaces evidence gaps; it does not authorize fabricated balancing adjustments.
